column1: # Weight 0 stops an affix being generated. MinTier is the lowest tier (1-7) it can appear on. T1..T7 are the min/max roll per tier.
# Ordinary inherited ranges scale by idol size. Corruption-only affixes use balanced Idol T1 ranges at every tier (base rules and affix-specific overrides in JewelAffixRules.CorruptionRange).
# Step: 0.01 makes the roll land only on whole 1% steps from the minimum (Damage as Extra
column2: Mana Leech only). 0 keeps it continuous.

column1: # Title is the word the item's own name is built from (Custom is the usual TitleType). Leave it empty to keep the game's wording.
# Weight is the roll weight against every other affix: Inherited rows started at the Idol's own 1 and are set to 100 here
column2: against 10 / 100 / 1000 for Exclusive rows. Weight 0 never rolls.
